title: Digitalis fhir-hub Implementation Guide
introduction: FHIR R4 conformance artifacts for the Digitalis FHIR interface: two contracts on two FHIR bases — Prescriptor, the prescribing sessions of $formulary-session, $createrx-session and $session-result, and Surveillance, whose $check-medication-request weighs proposed prescriptions against a patient's dossier and answers with the signals that fire.

list.desc: Two breaking changes and one addition on the surveillance contract. The operation is renamed: $check-medication becomes $check-medication-request, and the old name is not served. prescription is now required there (1..*), so a request carrying only medicationStatement is refused where it was checked before, and the invariant fhirhub-something-to-check is removed with it. And a second operation answers that question properly: $check-medication-statement checks a patient’s current medication with every entry under test, on a profile of its own that accepts no prescription. The response shape is unchanged for both. Nothing on the EVS contract changed.

Implements $check-medication: the request is weighed by the G-Standaard's medisch-farmaceutische beslisregels and the classic allergy, age, duplicate-medication and dose checks, and the signals come back as a Bundle of DetectedIssue. The request contract is unchanged from 0.2.0. Nothing on the EVS contract changed.

Adds the medication-surveillance contract on a second FHIR base: $check-medication, its request profile and its example. The operation itself is not implemented and answers 501. Nothing on the EVS contract changed.
First release. The three operations, 13 profiles, 2 extensions, 1 code system and 9 value sets.
